data.name: Ghostie Quest
data.detailed_description:
Ghostie Quest is back!


Can you master the pyramid of 100 levels? Tons of secrets and multiple ghosts to unlock across 4 game modes. Insanely cute! Insanely hard!

Become a family of ghosts in this spooky themed platform game. Unlock new ghosts, each new costume has it's own power. Artist ghosties can move blocks, knight ghosties can block projectiles with their shield, ninja ghosties can throw stars and much more. Multiple bosses and tons of secret levels await you. Gather lollipops and pizza to raise your score, and find plush ghostie toys to get extra lives. The farther you get the more game modes you unlock for further challenge for the most hardcore!

Local high score lists and automatic save progress ensures your hard won progress isn't lost. Can you solve the pyramid?

reviews.review:
Ghostie Quest is a retro platformer developed and published by Random Thoughts Enterainment that captures the spirit of classic arcade adventures with colorful pixel art, straightforward mechanics, and a heavy emphasis on skill. Rather than relying on elaborate storytelling or modern cinematic presentation, the game throws players into a mysterious pyramid packed with hazards, enemies, collectibles, and hidden surprises. Its nostalgic presentation immediately appeals to those who grew up with challenging platform games, while its accessible controls make it easy to understand even if mastering the adventure takes considerably more effort.

The game's biggest strength is the variety hidden beneath its simple appearance. As players make progress through the pyramid, they unlock different ghost forms that provide unique abilities capable of changing how individual stages are approached. One ghost specializes in manipulating blocks to solve environmental puzzles, another can defend itself with a shield against incoming attacks, while others introduce offensive or mobility-focused skills. These unlockable abilities prevent the gameplay from becoming repetitive across its one hundred levels, encouraging experimentation and rewarding players who learn when each ghost's strengths are most effective. The gradual introduction of these mechanics keeps the experience fresh while adding a satisfying sense of progression.

Exploration also plays a meaningful role throughout the adventure. Every stage contains collectibles ranging from candy and pizza for score bonuses to hidden ghost plush toys that award valuable extra lives. Secret areas and optional content encourage players to thoroughly examine each level rather than simply racing toward the exit. Multiple boss encounters help break up the traditional platforming stages, while several unlockable game modes provide additional replay value after completing the main journey. The game rewards curiosity just as much as platforming ability, giving completionists plenty of reasons to revisit earlier levels in search of everything they may have missed.

Visually, Ghostie Quest embraces its retro heritage with bright pixel graphics that remain charming despite their simplicity. The environments are colorful without becoming distracting, making it easy to distinguish enemies, hazards, and interactive objects. Character animations may be modest by modern standards, but they effectively communicate each ghost's personality and unique abilities. Combined with music that complements the spooky yet lighthearted atmosphere, the presentation successfully creates an adventure that feels nostalgic without becoming outdated purely for the sake of imitation.

Difficulty is unquestionably one of the game's defining characteristics. Ghostie Quest is intentionally demanding, requiring careful jumps, quick reflexes, and patience as players tackle increasingly complex platforming challenges. Later levels demand precision and repeated practice, making every successful run feel earned rather than handed to the player. This level of challenge will undoubtedly appeal to fans of classic platformers who enjoy mastering difficult stages, although newcomers or players looking for a more casual experience may find the steep learning curve frustrating. Fortunately, automatic saving helps reduce unnecessary repetition, allowing players to continue improving without losing significant progress.

Ghostie Quest succeeds by remaining faithful to the design principles of classic platform games while adding enough unique mechanics to stand apart from simple nostalgia projects. The combination of varied ghost abilities, extensive level count, collectible hunting, hidden content, boss battles, and unlockable game modes creates a surprisingly substantial adventure that offers many hours of gameplay. Although its uncompromising difficulty may not appeal to every player, those who appreciate old-school platforming challenges will likely find plenty to enjoy. Developed and published by Random Thoughts Enterainment, Ghostie Quest is a charming tribute to retro gaming that balances personality, replayability, and rewarding gameplay. 

Rating: 6/10
